definitions.text: Use an explicitly requested event by name or id. Tracker reports use the active event (events.is_active = 1). If an event scope is needed and none is clear, ask which event or whether to use the active event.

Amounts are integer cents. For whole-event financial totals, sum the saved sale_transactions total_revenue_cents, total_cost_cents and total_profit_cents. For a named product, join sale_transaction_items to products and sale_transactions, filter products.name, and sum the saved item revenue_cents, cost_cents or profit_cents. Current product prices and inventory costs are separate. Recorded Square revenue is gross. There is no verified field for Square fees, settlement adjustments, or processor net.

Completed-event reports include only sale_transactions.status = 'completed'. Use that filter for both financial summaries and sales unit totals unless the question explicitly requests reversal history. A reversed transaction remains in history with status = 'reversed' and reversed_at set. Undo restores consumed batch quantities.

Payment types are cash, square, free, and waste. Free and waste use zero recorded revenue and still incur cost and consume inventory. Overall completed-event totals include free and waste costs. Paid transactions filter payment_type IN ('cash', 'square'). Recorded waste sales filter payment_type = 'waste'.

For units sold, sum sale_transaction_items.quantity after joining sale_transactions for event, status, and payment filters. A transaction can contain multiple units. The tracker's default product report includes free units and excludes waste. Ask whether to count paid units only or include free units when scope is unclear. The tracker waste report counts completed waste sales by product. Manual inventory adjustments and bulk-batch discards are separate, and a combined waste definition is undecided.

Current stock sums remaining_quantity from inventory batches excluding inactive batches, grouped by inventory item and its tracking unit. Inventory usage links sale lines to consumed inventory and batches, and usage history can include reversed sales. Manual inventory adjustments are separately audited. Use saved sale costs for past sales.

Sale and reversal timestamps are stored as UTC ISO 8601 text. A reporting timezone, reference date for relative expressions, and business day boundary have not been chosen. Ask for explicit start/end timestamps or a UTC calendar range. Apply only the calendar interpretation explicitly provided. SQLite's local timezone is machine-specific.
